procedure.guidance: Before editing any source file: (1) write a minimal script that reproduces the reported behaviour and run it; (2) locate the code path with grep; (3) make the smallest change that fixes the reproduction; (4) re-run the reproduction and the closest existing tests; (5) remove the reproduction script before submitting.
procedure._comment: Example prompt-level skill for the R15 pilot (a generic procedure). Real skills come from Phase 4 induction on SWE-Gym.
